whatsNew.title: Kick what you copy into your library
whatsNew.step1: Copy some text and a football appears next to your cursor
whatsNew.step2: Click to shoot, or hold and pull back to aim
whatsNew.step3: Only a goal saves it: a wide shot bounces off the screen edges, and a miss saves nothing
whatsNew.autoNote: You use Auto capture, so copies don't show a reminder. Turning this on switches to Confirm capture; copies you don't kick are still saved when the countdown ends.
whatsNew.footnote: The circle reminder becomes a football. Switch back anytime in Settings → Capture.
whatsNew.toast: Football is on. Try it on your next copy
whatsNew.demoLabel: Demo: after copying a line, a football appears by the cursor; it is pulled back and released toward the goal, goes in and is saved
